content_sections.heading: About IIT Bhubaneswar Research and Entrepreneurship Park
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by IIT Bhubaneswar Research and Entrepreneurship Park, whose registered office is C/O IIT Bhubaneswar, Samantapuri, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751013. The Park runs the DAY-NRLM Incubator Programme, Odisha, with the Odisha Livelihoods Mission (OLM), to support growth-oriented micro-enterprises. The notice describes the positions as purely temporary/project-based and co-terminus with the programme, subject to the availability of funds and continuation of the project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from eligible Indian Nationals for 3 posts in total. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian Nationals may apply. For both posts the essential qualification is Post-Graduation in Business Management, Development Studies, Rural Management, Accounts, Economics or related fields, or a professional qualification such as CA/ICWA or equivalent. Age, qualification and experience are reckoned as on the last date of submission of applications. The notice prints no age limit. Experience: minimum 12–15 years of relevant experience in setting up and/or managing a manufacturing/business enterprise, preferably in food processing, handicrafts or related sectors, with experience in a leadership position. Demonstrated expertise in overall business operations, particularly sales, business development, accounts and enterprise management. Desirable: experience of working with government programmes, development institutions, entrepreneurship/incubation programmes or rural enterprises. Preferred: candidates with extensive industry/business networks and stakeholder-management experience. Experience: minimum three (03) years of experience in enterprise promotion/management in a functional area such as production, sales, procurement, business development or related functions. Preference may be given to candidates having experience in sales/business development. Candidates from premier institutions such as IRMA, IIMs, IITs, NITs and other institutions of similar repute may be preferred. Candidates must be willing to travel extensively within Odisha and provide hands-on mentoring and support to approximately 60–75 enterprises. Higher relevant qualifications and experience may be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated and stated per annum: up to ₹10,00,000 for the Project Lead and up to ₹12,00,000 for each Business Manager. It is subject to the applicable DAY-NRLM project norms, actuals-based reimbursement provisions and approval of the competent authority. The initial engagement is ordinarily for 12 months, extendable annually up to a maximum of three years, subject to satisfactory performance, achievement of approved KPIs, availability of funds and continuation of the programme. Selected personnel are engaged in accordance with the qualification and experience requirements of the DAY-NRLM Incubator Guidelines and are subject to approval by OLM before formal onboarding.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhubaneswar Research and Entrepreneurship Park Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice calls these responsibilities indicative and says they are not limited to the points below. Provide overall direction and guidance to the incubation team. Coordinate and supervise the work of Business Managers, Mentors and other project personnel. Interface with OLM, government officials, industry experts, financial institutions and other key stakeholders. Guide Business Managers in providing hands-on mentoring and support to incubated enterprises. Facilitate enterprise growth through business development, technology access, market linkages, standardisation, finance and other appropriate interventions. Review enterprise-level business and governance KPIs and ensure systematic monitoring of programme outcomes. Guide preparation and implementation of enterprise growth plans. Oversee the project MIS, reporting, documentation and knowledge products. Coordinate challenge fund-related activities and other programme activities as required. Participate in review meetings with OLM and other programme stakeholders. Ensure timely implementation of programme activities and achievement of approved project targets. Provide hands-on mentoring and handholding support to growth-oriented SHG enterprises. Assist enterprises in preparing and implementing business growth plans. Support enterprises in improving sales, production, procurement, financial management and business processes. Facilitate access to markets, finance, technology, registrations, certifications and other business-development services. Monitor enterprise performance against approved monthly, quarterly and annual KPIs. Identify enterprise-level gaps and facilitate appropriate technical/functional support. Coordinate with Mentors, functional experts and the Project Lead. Maintain enterprise-level records and contribute to project MIS and reporting. Undertake extensive field visits and provide regular enterprise-level support.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Bhubaneswar Research and Entrepreneurship Park Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online only, through the prescribed Google Application Form, which the notice refers to at the jobs page of the IIT Bhubaneswar website, with the application link given in the notice. Fill in all the mandatory details. Upload the prescribed documents/certificates in the specified format through the online form. Select the appropriate post, Project Lead or Business Manager, and complete the corresponding application details. Submit the form by 26 November 2026, 11.59 PM. Keep a copy or screenshot of the submitted application and the acknowledgement/application number generated after successful submission. Candidates should not send applications or supporting documents by email or post unless the Park specifically asks for them. The notice does not list the individual documents to be uploaded.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through screening of applications followed by a personal interview/e-interview. Applications are screened on the prescribed eligibility criteria, qualifications, relevant experience and supporting documents. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the interview. Selected personnel need OLM approval before formal onboarding. The notice gives no interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in the IIT Bhubaneswar Research and Entrepreneurship Park recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: 01 Project Lead – Full Time and 02 Business Manager, under the DAY-NRLM Incubator Programme, Odisha.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date and time for submission is 26 November 2026, 11.59 PM. The notice says applications submitted after the closing date and time may not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: For both posts, Post-Graduation in Business Management, Development Studies, Rural Management, Accounts, Economics or related fields, or a professional qualification such as CA/ICWA or equivalent. The Project Lead needs a minimum of 12–15 years of relevant experience. The Business Manager needs a minimum of three (03) years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Lead and Business Manager posts?
faq.answer: The Project Lead gets up to ₹10,00,000 per annum consolidated, and the Business Manager gets up to ₹12,00,000 per annum consolidated. Both are subject to applicable project norms and approval.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online only through the prescribed Google Application Form. Select the appropriate post, upload the prescribed documents and submit by 26 November 2026, 11.59 PM. Do not send applications by email or post unless specifically requested.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are screened first, and only shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview/e-interview. Selected personnel are subject to OLM approval before formal onboarding.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is contractual/project-based and co-terminus with the DAY-NRLM Incubator Programme. It gives no right or claim to regular employment at IIT Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q8. For how long is the engagement?
faq.answer: The initial engagement is ordinarily for 12 months. It is extendable annually up to a maximum of three years, subject to satisfactory performance, approved KPIs, availability of funds and continuation of the programme.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need an NOC if I am already employed?
faq.answer: Candidates already in regular employment shall apply through proper channel or produce an NOC from their present employer at the appropriate stage of the selection process.

faq.question: Q10. As on which date are age, qualification and experience counted?
faq.answer: They are reckoned as on the last date of submission of applications, which is 26 November 2026.
